title: validate_attachments: Unicode line terminators (U+0085 etc) bypass CRLF byte check
description: content_type byte check (b < 0x20 || b == 0x7f) passes multi-byte UTF-8 sequences including U+0085 (NEL), U+2028, U+2029 — Unicode line terminators that some HTTP/1.1 parsers treat as CRLF. In practice hyper's HeaderValue rejects non-ASCII at serve time, but the stated contract ('no control characters') is not fully enforced at the boundary. Fix: add a check that content_type is ASCII-only (all bytes <= 0x7e) after the control-char check, or use content_type.is_ascii() as a precondition.
